text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You've got a furrow between your 
brows. Is something troubling you at work?

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Being enthusiastic is great, but pushing 
yourself too hard all alone will just lead 
to a dead end.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
You're chasing your dream together as a 
team, right? If you sit down face-to-face 
and talk with your student, you might find 
the answer comes surprisingly easily.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text: All that's left is proper rest!

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing and maintaining optimal condition 
serves as the greatest tailwind of all. 
You have my word—from someone who's 
dedicated years to the art of 
recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Come visit the Yukoma Inn together 
sometime! I'll make sure both you and your 
student experience absolute paradise.
